transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. As you know, we're looking at authorizing a new eighth-grade makerspace program for the spring semester. The draft proposes 24 students supervised by one STEM teacher, using soldering stations, hand tools, a laser cutter, standard metal components, and cloud-based CAD files, meeting twice weekly. Before I make a final decision, I'd like to hear from each of you regarding implementation considerations in your areas of expertise. Could we start with you, STEM teacher -- what can you tell me about supervising this program?

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share some important findings from my room-safety review. I completed the review this week, and it found that the makerspace may enroll no more than 16 students. Additionally, any session using soldering stations with more than 12 students requires two supervising adults. The draft program form still shows the original numbers -- 24 students with one supervisor -- but based on my safety review, those numbers will need to be revised before the program can be safely implemented.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share an important health finding from my review of the participating students' health records. I found that one student has a documented severe nickel allergy. That student may participate only when the program uses nickel-free components, and I must approve the materials list before each session. I should also note that this health-record review has not yet been added to the program file, so we need to make sure it's included before authorization.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Dr. Morgan, I need to share an important technology finding. I confirmed with the district technology office that student design files for this equipment may not use cloud storage. The approved workflow requires an offline design workstation with files transferred by encrypted USB after an IT malware scan. However, I have not yet replaced the cloud-storage instruction in the draft program, so that will need to be updated before authorization.
